what: AU Hawk tuning (br-bwju.12): the doughnut. pig-catcher on the flat tarmac skidpad, from rest, full left lock and full throttle for 8 s (closed throttle for the first 0.5 s while the car settles on its wheels, so the throttle is a punch). Compare the same fixture across the roster: the AU Hawk is the burnout king (its tail hangs out furthest, longest, round the tightest circle); every other car sits below it. Envelopes are per car; docs/evidence/P1-V-au-hawk/tuning.md has the table.
